description: This file defines the Affiliate controller class for handling affiliate-related email notifications in the OpenCart e-commerce platform. It includes methods for sending affiliate registration emails and alerts to administrators.

classes.name: Affiliate
classes.description: Controller class for managing affiliate email notifications, including registration and alert emails.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Handles sending the affiliate registration email to the new affiliate.

methods.name: alert
methods.description: Sends alert emails to admin or specified addresses when a new affiliate registers, if enabled.
